hiddenConvention: PlayStation hides 28 of these until earned. The kit list does not tag them per trophy, so this guide marks story missions and cryptic one-off beats as hidden (the PSN convention) and leaves count, collectible and free-roam trophies visible.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum and unlocks only after the other 54 trophies pop, so treat it as the finish line rather than a task. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the contact strands before the point of no return, then collectibles and activities in free roam. Keep an eye on the missable flags in this tracker so a late-story lockout never forces a second playthrough. The two golds (final mission and 100% completion) are the usual last hurdles before this one lands.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Perform a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle to knock someone down, bowling-over style. Grab a bat or similar, drive slowly past a target, and time the swing as you pass. It is a free-roam stunt you can attempt repeatedly, so unmissable. A slow pass gives you the best timing window; expect a wanted level afterwards.

trophies.roadmapNote: Melee drive-by knockdown — a repeatable free-roam stunt.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder Marked Bills through your contacts until you've earned $250,000 from it. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, so keep robbing and then funnel the dirty money through the contact laundering system. The return is a fraction of the face value, so you'll need to process a lot — build up a stock of marked bills from vault jobs and armored trucks. It is unmissable and accumulates, but it rewards consistent robbery play.

sources.label: PSNProfiles · GTA VI PS5 trophy list

trophies.roadmapNote: Launder $250k of marked bills — feeds off robbery income over time.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across the game's shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles, properties and upgrades all count. The total is lifetime spending, so buy the things you actually need for other trophies (ammo, car upgrades, garage properties) and the counter climbs. It is unmissable as long as you keep earning and spending. Heist and race income make this trivial to reach by the endgame.

sources.label: PSNProfiles · GTA VI PS5 trophy list

trophies.roadmapNote: Spend $100k in shops — climbs naturally as you buy gear and property.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property — the starter notes eight of them. Garages are purchasable properties on the map that let you store vehicles, so acquire each as you can afford it. They remain for sale in free roam, making this unmissable, but they cost money, so build up cash from heists and races first. Owning them also helps the vehicle-discovery trophy by giving you storage for your collection.

sources.label: PSNProfiles · GTA VI PS5 trophy list

trophies.roadmapNote: Buy all 8 garage properties — needs cash, done in free roam.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Use the in-game Scooter Bros app to register 10 vehicles. Find the app on the phone, then register different vehicles you come across — the count is about distinct registrations. It is a free-roam task you can complete any time, so unmissable. Register vehicles as you discover them for the Whip It Good trophy to double up progress efficiently.
